summary: Open Text Corp filed an 8-K announcing a quarterly cash dividend of $0.275 per share, declared by the board, payable June 19, 2026, to shareholders of record June 5, 2026. This is a routine capital return event under the company's dividend policy. The filing also includes a furnished press release of Q3 FY2026 financial results under Item 2.02. The dividend declaration is a routine, ongoing program, not a special situation. No advisor or deal terms are disclosed. Watch for potential changes in dividend policy or leverage constraints.
